_about: The MODERN claim map (planning steps 182 and 186): which control a point of the view is on when the layer plays `--controls modern`, every 4th unit, at 16:9 and 4:3 at several ticks of a level's age with clear-portals hidden and shown, an early shot's state, the weightless level, the other two looks and three more window shapes. TWO ARRANGEMENTS of the walk arrows: the entries named `modern claim <state>` are the SPLIT one that ships (walk_left in the bottom-left corner, walk_right in the bottom-right one: the owner's decision of 2026-10-16), the entries named `modern claim arrows=grouped <state>` the GROUPED one (both at the bottom left: planning step 180's, kept as an alternative) with the values the golden held before, byte for byte. Every value is DERIVED from the independent model out/parity/program/CTL/CTL6b/work/model_claim_ctl6b.py (written from the design's section 1 and the owner's decision alone, no line of the module or the layer), never recorded from the binary alone; that model reproduces the 28 grouped values. It is never re-recorded to make a change pass: if the layout changes on purpose, the step says so and records why. Hashes are FNV-1a over one claim code per point; no pixel and no Asantee byte is here. PLANNING STEP 232 (the owner's ruling of 2026-11-08, his 3-09 report: the left walk arrow covered the bottom-left corner): the two walk arrows' hit rectangles no longer run to the view's edge (hit.walk_edge_reach_px 0; the corner buttons keep edge_reach_px 48), so the strip beside and under an arrow is the world's. Every value was re-derived by the same independent model with an edge reach per control, never recorded from the binary: the values of the states in which no arrow is in the view (the first ticks, the weightless level) and the corner buttons' counts are unchanged, the arrows' counts (and so every hash that has an arrow in it) are not. THE model_claim_ctl6b.py NAMED ABOVE IS THE PRE-STEP-232 ORIGINAL (one edge reach for every control) and cannot reproduce this file: the step-232 copies are out/parity/program/CTL/CTL6b/work/model_claim_ctl6b_step232.py (the model with a reach per control: python -B -I <it> tests/golden/modern_claim.json from the repository root exits 0, 56 entries, 0 differ, checked 2026-11-08) and out/parity/program/CTL/CTL6b/work/write_claim_step232.py (recomputes every entry and writes modern_claim_new_step232.json beside it). They are LOCAL copies, persistent in the gitignored out/, and not committed: a fresh clone has neither.
